body:
_**# 📝 SkyPrivate Plugin Description**_
🛡️ SkyPrivate: Advanced Region Claiming and Grief Prevention (1.16.5) SkyPrivate is a custom, lightweight land-claiming and protection solution for Minecraft 1.16.5 (Paper). It provides players with robust tools to define, manage, and secure their own territories, offering granular control over block interaction and entity combat within their claimed zones.✨ Core FeaturesIntuitive Region Selection:Players can easily select two corner points using a specialized tool (e.g., a wooden axe) to define the boundaries of their private land.Permanent Block Protection:Once a region is successfully claimed, unauthorized users are completely prevented from placing, breaking, or interacting with blocks, chests, doors, and other containers within the secured area.Flexible Trust System:Owners can grant specific privileges to friends or trusted players using commands, allowing them to build or interact within the claim without full ownership rights.Custom Damage Flagging:Unique Feature: Owners gain control over entity interactions by toggling a dedicated flag to:Allow/Deny All Damage: Globally permit or prohibit any form of damage to any entity (including mobs, animals, and other players) within the private area. Perfect for establishing safe zones or dedicated PvP arenas within a protected region.
🚀 CommandsCommandDescription
 /spl create [NAME_OF_REGION] - Finalizes the selection and claims the region.
 /spl del [NAME_OF_REGION] - Delete region.
 /spl addmember <player> - Adds new member in region.
 /spl delmember <player> - Delete member from region.
 /spl flag <pvp/damage/interact> <allow/deny> - Flags.
 /spl info - Shows region on your cordinate.
 /spl help - Shows all comands of this plugin!
🔧 Technical SpecificationsPlatform: Paper. Minecraft Version: 1.16.5 Dependence: WorldEdit.
